editorial:
Captain Jack Sparrow is back, but this time he's in real trouble. A crew of ghost sailors led by the scary Captain Salazar is hunting him down, and Jack's only way out is finding the legendary Trident of Poseidon. Along the way, he teams up with a smart astronomer and a young navy guy who has his own secrets. The movie brings back the fun, swashbuckling spirit you expect, with big action scenes, silly jokes, and plenty of pirate chaos. It feels like a return to the adventure style of the first film, even if it doesn't quite reach those heights.

The action is big and loud, with ghost ships, sea battles, and some wild stunts that keep things moving. Johnny Depp is still funny as Jack, though the movie leans hard on his usual tricks. The new characters add fresh energy, and the visuals look great in 4K. On the downside, the story can feel a bit messy and some jokes fall flat. Still, if you want a fun popcorn movie, this one delivers. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Jack and his friends reach the Trident of Poseidon, which controls the sea. Salazar gets his hands on it, but Henry breaks the Trident, breaking the curse that trapped Salazar and his crew. The ghost sailors turn to dust and disappear. Jack escapes, and Henry reunites with his father, Will Turner, who is freed from his curse. The movie ends with Jack sailing off into the sunset with his crew, ready for more adventures. A post-credits scene hints that Davy Jones might return.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves swashbuckling adventure and pirate action.
